episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Because she cannot afford to pay to keep her there, Lee Ji An sneaks her grandmother out of her assisted living facility. Park Sang Hoon is humiliated at his daughter's wedding.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Ji An uses the bribe money to pay off the loan shark. Dong Hoon is in a lot of trouble at work.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Joon Young tells Yoon Hee that he will take care of everything. Director Park and Dong Hoon try to figure out who is trying to set them up and why.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Director Park goes down to Busan to dig up dirt on Joon Young in secret. Ji An collects her first payment.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Ki Hoon recognizes someone from his past. Ji An continues to learn about the brothers.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Dong Hoon finds out who has been calling Joon Young.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Dong Hoon confronts Joon Young. Ji An gets some advice about her grandmother from Dong Hoon.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Joon Young is disturbed by what Dong Hoon said to him, and Yoon Hee can't forget what Ji An shared with her.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Ji An encourages Dong Hoon to become a director. The brothers bemoan their lack of success and what it will mean when their mother passes.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The brothers rally around Dong Hoon when they find out he was in a fight. Ji An repays her debt.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Dong Hoon prepares for the screening interview. Joon Young has his office swept for bugs.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Dong Hoon must figure out what he wants to do now. Ji An meets the brothers.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Ji An confronts Joon Young. Ki Bum asks Ji An to run away with him before they get caught

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: When she doesn't show up for work or answer her phone, Dong Hoon goes looking for Ji An.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Dong Hoon and Yoon Hee offer to help Ji An.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: The brothers rush to support Ji An when she suffers a great loss.
